metadata.question: Were crops near the southern Iberian Peninsula healthier (indicated with NDVI) from March 25 to April 23, 2023 as compared to the longer-term average from 2000-2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Southern Iberian Peninsula (Spain/Portugal coast, roughly 36-38°N, 6-8°W) - Time periods: March 25 - April 23, 2023 vs same period 2000-2010 - Collection: MODIS Terra (MOD13Q1) for NDVI - good long-term coverage from 2000 - Alternative: Landsat or Sentinel-2, but MODIS better for 2000-2010 baseline 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flags from MODIS to mask clouds/poor quality pixels - Focus on cropland areas (can use land cover mask or just analyze the region) 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for 2023 period - Calculate mean NDVI for 2000-2010 baseline (same dates each year) - Valid Zero: NDVI can be low (0.1-0.3) for crops in early spring - Null/Error: If no data or calculation fails → C1/C2/C3 - Compare: If 2023 NDVI > baseline → A (healthier), else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region - southern Iberian Peninsula (cropland areas) const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-8.0, 36.0], [-8.0, 38.5], [-5.5, 38.5], [-5.5, 36.0], [-8.0, 36.0]] ]); // 2. Load MODIS NDVI data (16-day composite, 250m resolution) const modisNDVI = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .select('NDVI'); // Quality masking function function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('SummaryQA'); const mask = qa.eq(0); // 0 = good quality return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get 2023 data (March 25 - April 23) const ndvi2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2023-03-25', '2023-04-24') .map(maskQuality) .select('NDVI'); const count2023 = ndvi2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023 Images found: ${count2023}`); if (count2023 === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data for 2023 period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get 2000-2010 baseline (same date range each year) const years = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2010); const baselineImages = years.map(function(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 3, 25); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 4, 24); return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskQuality) .select('NDVI') .mean(); }); const baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(baselineImages); const countBaseline = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline years processed: ${countBaseline}`); if (countBaseline === 0) { console.log('No baseline data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean NDVI for both periods const mean2023 = ndvi2023.mean(); const meanBaseline = baselineCol.mean(); // 6. Get statistics with pixel count const stats2023 = mean2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsBaseline = meanBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi2023Val = stats2023.NDVI_mean; const pixels2023 = stats2023.NDVI_count; const ndviBaselineVal = statsBaseline.NDVI_mean; const pixelsBaseline = statsBaseline.NDVI_count; console.log(`2023 NDVI: ${ndvi2023Val !== null ? (ndvi2023Val * 0.0001).toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Valid pixels: ${pixels2023 || 0}`); console.log(`Baseline NDVI (2000-2010): ${ndviBaselineVal !== null ? (ndviBaselineVal * 0.0001).toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Valid pixels: ${pixelsBaseline || 0}`); // 7. Validation if (pixels2023 === 0 || pixelsBaseline === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (ndvi2023Val === null || ndviBaselineVal === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // MODIS NDVI has scale factor 0.0001, range -2000 to 10000 const ndvi2023Scaled = ndvi2023Val * 0.0001; const ndviBaselineScaled = ndviBaselineVal * 0.0001; if (ndvi2023Scaled < -1 || ndvi2023Scaled > 1 || ndviBaselineScaled < -1 || ndviBaselineScaled > 1) { console.log('NDVI values out of valid range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare and answer const difference = ndvi2023Scaled - ndviBaselineScaled; console.log(`Difference (2023 - Baseline): ${difference.toFixed(4)}`); if (ndvi2023Scaled > ndviBaselineScaled) { console.log('Crops were healthier in 2023 compared to 2000-2010 baseline.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Crops were not healthier in 2023 compared to baseline.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
